answer: Each validator locks a stake C and is subject to a superlinear slashing function S(k)=αk^β (β>1) tied to a zero-knowledge verifiable delay τ that bounds detection time. An adversary controlling fraction f of total stake obtains expected utility U = f·R − Σ_i αk_i^β·Pr[detect_i]; the inequality Σ_i αk_i^β·Pr[detect_i] > f·R forces U < 0, eliminating profitable deviation. Consequently no Sybil harbor can sustain a coalition that tries to forge identities, and the resulting economic haven guarantees honest participation.
